info.title: Northline Outdoor
info.description: Northline Outdoor — a sample Shopify storefront (20 products: tents, packs, shells, boots, camp kitchen, sleep + light; lifetime warranty, free US shipping over $75) demonstrating the Busymate AI Shopify app: grounded product/policy chat, an MCP server over the store's own data, WebMCP in-page cart actions, and identified-visitor order lookup.

flows.title: list products
flows.description: List every product Northline Outdoor sells, with price and stock.

flows.title: search products
flows.description: Search Northline Outdoor's catalog by name or keyword.

flows.title: get product
flows.description: Get one product's full detail by SKU.

flows.title: get order status
flows.description: Look up an order's status and tracking by order number + the email on the order. Call it as soon as a shopper asks about an order — even before they give the number: the call shows an order-lookup card in the chat where they type it. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor on a real store.

flows.title: start return
flows.description: Start a return for an item on an order. Call it as soon as a shopper wants to return something — the call shows a return card in the chat where they pick the order, the item and the reason. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor on a real store; this demo does not actually process anything.

flows.title: add to cart
flows.description: Add a product (by SKU, optionally a specific variant) to this visitor's cart on this page. The cart badge and drawer update immediately.

flows.title: view cart
flows.description: Show what's currently in this visitor's cart with line totals, subtotal, shipping and total.
